scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/frontend && npm install --prefix apps/backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/frontend" "npm run start:dev --prefix apps/backend"
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:db && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/frontend
